solution_summary: London Stock Exchange Group standardized identity, device, or threat operations on Windows 365 and GitHub Copilot after determining that London Stock Exchange Group increases productivity with Windows 365. Signals from endpoints, identities, email, and cloud services are brought into one governed operating model so analysts or IT teams can work from a smaller number of tools and policies instead of stitching together manual processes. Cloud-managed controls handle tasks such as access governance, patching, compliance, hunting, or endpoint rollout, which means the security and operations posture improves as part of the platform itself rather than as a separate project. This gives the organization a faster path from detection or policy change to remediation while reducing operational drag on employees, and London Stock Exchange Group’s developers had previously navigated between multiple desktops.
